name: bounded-workflow
description: A minimal discover, execute, verify workflow.

tasks.prompt: Map the target for {{var:GOAL}}. Derive objectively verifiable acceptance items and return their task coverage, concrete source-grounded paths or symbols, constraints, dependencies, ownership conflicts, exact verification commands, unknowns, and whether an end-to-end tracer must precede parallel work.
acceptance: Returns a scoped map with concrete evidence paths, causal dependencies, and named unknowns.

tasks.prompt:
Complete only the bounded work and acceptance items assigned to this task for {{var:GOAL}}. Preserve recorded decisions and report exact verification evidence using this map:
{{output:discover}}
acceptance: Completes only the owned scope and reports exact verification commands and observed results.
Returns explicit pass, revise, or blocked coverage for every declared upstream criterion.
